_comment: Engine parameters. Edit here, not in code. Weights order: water, soil, income, risk.
_soil_water_comment: Plant-available water at sowing = (min(wetness*porosity, field_capacity) - wilting_point) * root_zone_m. Wetness is NASA POWER GWETROOT (MERRA-2 root zone, ~1 m), averaged +-3 days around the sowing date over the past 5 years. Field capacity and wilting point: midpoints of FAO-56 Table 19 (Allen et al. 1998) for sand / loam / clay. Porosity: Rawls, Brakensiek & Saxton (1982) for sand / loam / clay.
_delivery_comment: Water reaching the field (suuplan/delivery.py). national_irrigation_m3: water used for irrigation in 2024, Water Resources Service of Kyrgyzstan (6.19 billion m3), spread over all farmland seen by ESA WorldCereal. kostyakov: canal seepage loss sigma = A / Q^m % per km (A. N. Kostyakov; A, m for high / medium / low permeability soils). canal_flow_m3s: assumed flow of the farm canal. field_efficiency: surface (furrow) irrigation, FAO Irrigation Water Management Training Manual 4 (Brouwer et al. 1989). delivery_levels: useful water / plan need at or above which the computed supply counts as 'enough' or 'sometimes short'; below that it is 'often short'.
